result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by active construction, with a portable toilet and debris piles completely obstructing the sidewalk and corner. There are no marked crosswalks or visible curb ramps, forcing pedestrians to navigate around physical barriers and into the roadway to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: Absence of marked crosswalks and curb ramps at an intersection increases pedestrian exposure.

result.summary: The residential street features sidewalks on both sides, but the right-hand walkway is completely obstructed by construction materials and traffic cones. There is a total lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps, at the visible intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Remove construction materials from the sidewalk to restore pedestrian access.

result.summary: The environment features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but it is significantly degraded by maintenance issues. Large amounts of debris obstruct the walkway, and road markings are faded, reducing the overall safety and accessibility of the intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pile of furniture and debris completely blocks the sidewalk on the left corner, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground on the sidewalk corner

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, making the crossing less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Poor Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt is cracked and uneven, creating potential trip hazards for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Enforcement
interventions.description: Remove the debris and furniture blocking the public right-of-way to restore pedestrian access.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with high-visibility continental (ladder) markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersection
interventions.description: Ensure sightlines are clear at the corner by removing visual obstructions and preventing parking near the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with a paved sidewalk on the left and an unpaved, dirt shoulder on the right. There is a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings, traffic control devices, or ADA-compliant infrastructure visible in the immediate environment.
